findings.original: Decision OHLC/clock/segment matched but symbol was unbound, allowing another symbol decision/history to update the current position.
findings.resolution: Author now rejects decision symbol mismatch and explicit history symbol mismatch.

findings.original: next_stop=None reached pending update and set stop=None; string exit_next_open='false' was truthy; invalid callback could commit hold/decision state before rejection.
findings.resolution: Author treats None stop as no update, requires Mapping/bool exit flag, validates all updates before hold/last_decision/pending commit.

findings.original: Provided fill side was silently overwritten with order side; explicit receipt identity/episode binding was not checked.
findings.resolution: Author rejects provided side/identity/episode mismatches and boolean values before position or ledger mutation.

findings.original: Aggregate ledger ignored explicit impossible receipt availability and contradictory unit labels; retrospective valuation clock semantics were implicit.
findings.resolution: Author rejects provided available_ts_ms before event ts and wrong quantity_unit/cash_unit. Delayed receipts remain valid for explicitly retrospective event-time valuation, not causal as-of features.

findings.original: Observed receipt event time older than already consumed detail could install or resize exposure without revisiting earlier stop/MAE conditions. Related boundary: a fully pre-entry detail ending exactly at known receipt entry could be misclassified as a stop.
findings.origin: PR1343 automated review, independently confirmed by source review; adjacent equality case found by independent reviewer.
findings.resolution: RECEIPT_ONLY fill stamp before consumed detail.close rejects before any state mutation. Boundary equality is allowed for next interval. RECEIPT_ONLY detail ending at/before entry skips pre-entry stop/MFE; MODEL internal same-bar fills are unchanged.

findings.original: cancel() could change filled/closed/cancelled/expired order or episode classification, including changing CLOSED to CANCELLED.
findings.origin: PR1343 automated review, independently confirmed by source review.
findings.resolution: Cancellation requires PENDING/PARTIAL order state and strictly positive remaining order quantity before any state change. Partial residual cancellation still preserves held position, ledger and protective stop.

integration_requirements: Rule digest certifies metadata list only. Whole identity must also pin normalized full config, timeframe/source clock, symbol overrides, actual code closure and input hashes.

Source truth, receipt authenticity and underlying unit normalization remain separate caller evidence; presence of strings or hashes is not proof.
